tasks.prompt: In the web app, add an API endpoint `GET /api/tags/count` that returns, as a JSON number, how many tags the current workspace has. It takes an optional `search` query parameter: when it is given, only tags whose name contains it are counted.

In the web app, add an API endpoint `GET /api/logs/[logId]` that returns one API request log of the current workspace, enriched the same way the log list endpoint enriches logs. Respond with a not-found error when the log does not exist in this workspace, and also when the log is older than the workspace plan's log retention period (the message should say that upgrading the plan shows more logs).

concerns.siblings: accepted rule: HTTP handlers in app/** do not throw a bare Error

tasks.prompt: In the server, add a controller mounted at `/view` with two GET endpoints: `/view/folder/unique-paths` returns the unique folder paths of the current user's assets, and `/view/folder?path=<path>` returns the current user's assets directly inside that folder. `ViewService` already implements both. Register the controller with the others. You may skip regenerating the OpenAPI spec and SDK.
In the server, add an endpoint `GET /tags/:id` that returns one of the current user's tags by its id. `TagService` already has the method for it. You may skip regenerating the OpenAPI spec and SDK.

concerns.siblings: every :id handler in tag.controller.ts takes UUIDParamDto

tasks.prompt: In the backend, add two endpoints under `/api/v1/user-action`: `POST` with body `{ action }` records that the current user performed that action and returns `{ message, userAction }`; `GET` with query parameter `action` returns `{ userAction }` for the current user (null when they never did it). The user service already has `createUserAction` and `getUserAction`. Register the routes with the other v1 routes.

In the backend, add the endpoint `POST /api/v1/workspace/:workspaceId/key` that uploads a project key for another member of the project: the body is `{ key: { encryptedKey, nonce, userId } }`; it calls the project key service's `uploadProjectKeys` on behalf of the current user and returns `{ message }`. Register it with the other v1 routes under `/workspace`.

In the API, add a tRPC router `tags` with four procedures for the current team's tags: `get` (list them), `create` (`{ name }`), `update` (`{ id, name }`) and `delete` (`{ id }`). The database queries (`getTags`, `createTag`, `updateTag`, `deleteTag`) and the input schemas in `@api/schemas/tags` already exist. Add the router to the app router.

In the backend, add an endpoint `DELETE /api/v1/items/{id}` that deletes an item and returns the message 'Item deleted successfully'. Only the item's owner or a superuser may delete it: respond 404 when the item does not exist and 403 when the caller is someone else.

concerns.siblings: 12/18 (67%) of backend/app/api/routes entry points; every items.py handler
